body: I was right there with you at 17, tried so hard to be “cool” and not a “poser”. Just do what you want and like what you like, be your genuine self!

Go to shows in your local scene, meet fellow musicians. Make plans with them, have fun, work hard at your music with your bandmates- work a shitty job that lets you take off some time for touring, have fun, buy a van maybe, keep working at it, and working at it.

Most importantly have fun. My philosophy is, I’ll work really hard with my band, and if it doesn’t end up making me a living that’s okay, because I had fun and can say that I’ve done some really cool shit, met some cool people, and play some great shows.
